fields.label: caption
fields.A: A 17.7-second mono 16 kHz recording contains a two-speaker English dialogue with six speaker changes and occasional overlap. The speakers discuss how to provide scores in a file format, mentioning dialogue numbers and combining both scores in one file. The acoustic background is relatively clean with no detected music or external noise categories, short silences, low reverberation, and high early-to-late sound ratio.
fields.B: The text reads as a first-person conversational utterance in which the person indicates they can provide information in the requested format, prefers dialogue number followed by the score, and notes both scores can be placed in one file. A <gap> placeholder appears in the text.
